scope: National freshwater waterbody source discovery; not a Philippines lake extraction, site inventory, or species-occurrence review.

dataset.title: HydroLAKES version 1 global lake and reservoir polygons
dataset.publishedReference: Lehner, B., Messager, M.L. (2016). HydroLAKES: Global Lake and Reservoir Database. Environmental Data Initiative. Nature Communications 7, 13603. DOI: 10.1038/ncomms13603.
dataset.licenseEvidence: The official HydroSHEDS HydroLAKES product page states that the database is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License.
dataset.statedPurpose: Shoreline polygons for global lakes with a surface area of at least 10 hectares; lake records are co-registered to HydroRIVERS reaches and HydroBASINS sub-basins via shared identifiers.

decision.use: Use as a candidate national lake/reservoir discovery layer after extracting a Philippines subset from the official source, recording a source hash, and validating its waterbody names and geometry against Philippine references.
limitations: The stated 10-hectare threshold excludes smaller lakes and ponds, so HydroLAKES cannot serve as a complete inland-water inventory.
The product page describes mostly geometric fields; its records are not fish observations, habitat validation, water-quality measurements, catchability, or fishing-access evidence.
A global source layer requires a documented Philippines extraction and regional crosswalk before it can support the Luzon-first, then Visayas and Mindanao rollout.
The CC BY 4.0 source license permits attribution-based reuse under its terms, but this review does not approve any geometry for public application use.
next: Acquire the official HydroLAKES polygon archive or a documented official subset; record retrieval date and SHA-256.
Extract Philippines features, report the row count, and identify mapped lakes/reservoirs by name and stable source ID without treating names as fish evidence.
Crosswalk candidate waterbodies against licensed Philippine administrative and local waterbody sources before assigning rollout regions.
For each validated lake/reservoir, seek independent site-linked fish sources; keep species records and public assertions separate from the hydrology layer.
Track waterbodies below 10 hectares and wetlands/ponds through additional national and regional sources.

accessReview.directDownloadSizes: The official product page lists global polygon downloads of 763 MB (file geodatabase) and 820 MB (shapefile), plus 81 MB and 79 MB pour-point products.
accessReview.notes: The official page supplies direct global archives but no Philippines-only product on the page reviewed. No archive was downloaded, no regional API or third-party mirror was treated as authoritative, and no extract or geometry was produced.
